purpose: Test whether the V117 pulse QPR instability is caused by service delay redistributed from current critical-frontier players onto other current players: retain V113 bit-for-bit and require complete native-order componentwise service non-worsening for every current player.

mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.strongest_relevant_parent: V117 passed all three throughput gates and both QPR conventions for spike and sustained. Pulse throughput passed, but pulse QPR failed only the two-of-three direction rule while its mean remained positive (+0.538%).
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.observed_pulse_failure: E920 lost four fixed-window completions and slightly worsened latency/cost. E921 gained fourteen completions but worsened both mean latency and cost enough to reduce QPR. E922 improved all three factors.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.causal_gap: V117 compares only the frozen current critical-frontier players. Native-order replay may protect that subset while shifting admitted queue delay onto a noncritical current player, increasing cohort mean latency or cost despite non-worse critical-player service.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.independent_axis: Replace the critical-frontier-only componentwise certificate with the same coefficient-free service comparison over the complete frozen current player set.

closed_axes.admitted_work_definition: pending plus all resident remaining plus same-window projected immutable CPU remains bit-for-bit V113
closed_axes.critical_frontier_membership: used by the existing V113 substitution rule but not as the V118 complete comparison scope

hypothesis.primary: A complete alternative can preserve every current critical player yet delay another current player through its replay prefix. This hidden redistribution raises mean latency/cost and explains the pulse QPR sign reversals.
hypothesis.candidate: Replay complete anchor and alternative independently in the same frozen native player order. Immediately before adding each current player, compute the same V113 causal admitted-work service proxy. Accept only if every alternative proxy is finite and no greater than the matching anchor proxy plus the existing EPSILON, in addition to every existing V113 certificate.
hypothesis.falsification: The hypothesis fails if the sole candidate does not pass all nine frozen throughput/QPR gates on the complete fresh E923-E925 cohort.

allowed: all immutable and current-state V113 admitted-work, locality, resource, routed-score, OCS, welfare, feasibility, and player-order inputs
the anchor and alternative assignments already constructed by V113
the per-current-player V113 service proxy evaluated immediately before that player is added to each independent replay
forbidden: completion count, throughput, latency, cost, QPR, SLA outcome, or any completed-request aggregate
future arrivals, future completion, future container state, or future child placement
workload scenario, burst label, seed identity, registered burst interval, or time-to-burst-boundary
any E920-E922 result-derived threshold, margin, ratio, horizon, coefficient, cap, or smoothing width
formal E01-E20 outcome-dependent selection or confirmation outcomes before a training pass
information_boundary.componentwise_definition: For every player in the frozen current players sequence, alternative_proxy <= anchor_proxy + existing EPSILON. Missing, negative, nonfinite, infeasible, or incomplete evidence rejects the entire alternative.
information_boundary.fail_closed: Any unavailable player proxy, player coverage mismatch, incomplete assignment, replay infeasibility, or failed V113 certificate preserves the exact anchor assignment.

arms.complete_all_player_service_rule: every current player's alternative admitted-work service proxy is no greater than its anchor proxy

candidate_mechanism.only_changed_axis: Add a complete all-current-player componentwise V113 service Pareto certificate after V113 constructs its anchor and alternative and before it may dispatch the alternative.
candidate_mechanism.reference_policy: Policy-independent offline reference construction remains unchanged.
candidate_mechanism.exact_anchor_invariant: Without complete finite all-player evidence and every frozen V113 certificate, dispatch exact V94 for identical state and candidates.

per_window: all frozen V113 causal-arrival, admitted-work, critical-service, score, welfare, assignment-hash, and feasibility fields

all-player gate enabled/evaluated/accepted, current-player count, compared-player count, unavailable count, worse-player count, maximum alternative-minus-anchor delta, and maximum alternative-to-anchor ratio when defined
performance fields retained but not opened before joint blind audit

selection_rule.throughput_gate_per_scenario: candidate three-seed mean is at least the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is nonnegative on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.qpr_gate_per_scenario_per_convention: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is strictly positive on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.E3_winner_requires: the sole candidate passes all three metrics in all three E3 scenarios
selection_rule.absolute_formal_n20_baseline_gates: diagnostic only and never used to select the V118 profile
